segments.ja386:1.1: Saccaṃ kirevamāhaṃsu, vastaṃ [bhastaṃ (sī. pī.), kalakaṃ (syā.), garaṃ (ka.)] bāloti paṇḍitā;
segments.ja386:1.3: Passa bālo rahokammaṃ, āvikubbaṃ na bujjhati.
segments.ja386:2.1: Tvaṃ khopi [tvaṃ nu kho (sī. syā.), tvañca kho (pī.)] samma bālosi, kharaputta vijānahi;
segments.ja386:3.1: Aparampi samma te bālyaṃ [ayampi samma te bālo (ka.)], yo mutto na palāyasi;
segments.ja386:3.3: So ca bālataro samma, yaṃ tvaṃ vahasi senakaṃ.
segments.ja386:4.1: Yaṃ nu samma ahaṃ bālo, ajarāja vijānahi;
segments.ja386:4.3: Atha kena senako bālo, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja386:5.1: Uttamatthaṃ labhitvāna, bhariyāya yo padassati [bhayiyā yo padassati (pī.), bhayiyā na bhavissati (ka.)];
segments.ja386:5.3: Tena jahissatattānaṃ, sā cevassa na hessati.
segments.ja386:6.1: Na ve piyammeti [na piyameti (ka.), na piyamedanti (katthaci)] janinda tādiso, attaṃ niraṃkatvā piyāni sevati [sevaye (?)];
segments.ja386:6.3: Attāva seyyo paramā ca seyyo, labbhā piyā ocitatthena pacchāti.

lines: Tattha tvaṃ khopi sammāti samma sindhava mayāpi kho tvaṃ bālataro.
Kharaputtāti so kira gadrabhassa jātako, tena taṃ evamāha.
Yo mutto na palāyasīti yo tvaṃ rathato mutto samāno muttakāle palāyitvā araññaṃ na pavisasi, taṃ te apalāyanaṃ aparampi bālyaṃ, so ca bālataroti yaṃ tvaṃ senakaṃ vahasi, so senako tayāpi bālataro.
